title: Microsoft Teams: Support human interpreter listening mode in Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows
description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows now supports human interpreter listening mode in meetings where organizers enable language interpretation in Meeting options, allowing room participants to select a language and hear interpreter audio.
